comment: The twenty-four microtune parameters are declared but have no ParamWidget: the note rows are a pair of custom widgets added with addChild (src/Quantizer.cpp:481-505, 542-552), so none of them appears in paramPos and no help click can reach one. They get no line, no tag and no props, and a Note covers them instead. The note on and off state is not a parameter at all; it is module state saved in the patch. The Offset knob is configured with a display multiplier of 12 and a range of -1 to +1, so its tooltip reads in semitones while the value is in volts; the Offset CV jack adds volts directly, which is why one volt there is a whole semitone rather than a twelfth of the knob. The quantiser works on a grid of 48 half-semitone slots over two octaves and picks the nearest enabled note (src/Quantizer.cpp:207-227). A directional preset makes the cents depend on whether the quantised note rose or fell from the last one (src/Quantizer.cpp:187-196). The panel prints Quanti2er, Amount and Offset; the three input and three output jacks carry no lettering. Layout is at src/Quantizer.cpp:520-570.
